newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska feedlot cattle sell at $108/dressed - USDA - April 8.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska feedlot cattle sell at $108/dressed - USDA - April 8.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers on a live basis were $0.50-$1.00 lower; dressed basis mostly $1.00 lower. Demand and seller interest, although somewhat uneven, improved in the afternoon.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered ( paid on hot carcass weights )
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1175-1325 lbs - 67.00-67.50; dressed basis mostly 108.00, instances 107.50 in far West ( weighted average 107.98 ).
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1200 lbs - 67.00-67.50; dressed basis mostly 108.00, instances to 107.00 in far West. ( weighted average 107.96 )
Confirmed - 8,000 Last Week - 13,800 Last Year - 28,000 For week - 17,000 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 23,600 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 33,600
